# Axiom AI

> Axiom AI helps companies make brand information easier to discover, verify, and understand across generative search and answer systems. The site covers GEO, AEO, crawl accessibility, structured data, answer-oriented content, and AI visibility measurement.

## Company
Axiom AI provides GEO/AEO consulting and implementation services. Its approach combines technical accessibility, factual content, structured organization and article data, consistent external references, and repeatable measurement.

## Contact
- Email: info@axiom-ai.su

## Services
- AI visibility diagnostics: review defined real user prompts, record brand mentions and citations, and compare results with named competitors.
- Technical accessibility: review robots.txt, crawl access, status codes, canonical URLs, sitemaps, rendering, and performance.
- Structured data: maintain Schema.org JSON-LD that accurately describes visible organization, article, FAQ, and how-to content.
- Answer-oriented content: create pages that answer a specific question directly and explain evidence and limitations.
- External entity consistency: align company information across relevant profiles, directories, media, and review sources.

## Site pages
- [FAQ](https://axiom-ai.su/faq): answers about GEO, crawlers, schema, and AI visibility.
- [Services](https://axiom-ai.su/services): GEO/AEO service scope.
- [Methodology](https://axiom-ai.su/methodology): diagnostics, implementation, and monitoring.
- [Glossary](https://axiom-ai.su/glossary): GEO/AEO terminology.


## Important notes
- This is an orientation document for agents that support llms.txt. It does not guarantee crawling, indexing, citations, rankings, or inclusion in AI answers.
- Google does not require llms.txt or special schema markup for inclusion in its AI search features. Crawlability, indexable content, and people-first quality remain important.
- Search crawlers and model-training crawlers have different purposes and separate controls. Review robots.txt before changing access preferences.
- Axiom AI does not guarantee rankings in AI answers. Outputs vary by prompt, platform, geography, time, and retrieval context.
